message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a beige background. The large red word "TEMPO" is at the top. Above it, black text reads "Lobi-lobi Ambang Batas Parlemen H.30" and "Bisnis Komando Koperasi Merah Putih H.76". Below the logo is the red phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A large black headline reads "SIAPA MELINDUNGI DIA". Smaller black text below discusses a person and a legal case.

In the foreground, a man with dark hair and a mustache crouches on a paved road. He wears a light blue polo shirt and brown trousers. He holds up a large, translucent plastic sheet that drapes over him. Part of the sheet's underside is dark red. In the background, a smaller figure in a tan vest, dark pants, and a white face mask walks on the road holding a magnifying glass. The road has yellow lines and curves into the distance. At the bottom left are a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "3-9 NOVEMBER 2025" and "RP 60.000".
